subject: Discrete Mathematics: Set Theory & Algebra
name: Set Theory
priorityEvidence: 27 PYQs extracted, tested from 1993 to 2021 across CSE and IT streams. Lower raw count than Relations/Group Theory but placed FIRST in study order because it's the direct prerequisite for Relations, Functions, and Group Theory — everything else in this subject is built on set notation and set-algebra identities.

unlocks.why: A relation is formally defined as a subset of a Cartesian product of sets — needs set notation fluency.
Functions are special relations; domain/codomain/range language directly reuses set vocabulary.
A group is a set with a binary operation satisfying closure/associativity/identity/inverse — needs comfort with set-based definitions.
Functional dependency / attribute-closure reasoning in DBMS is set-based (closures, subsets of attributes).

crossLinks.note: Inclusion-Exclusion word problems (persons who eat X, Y, Z) are the same skill tested as a GA question.
